title: 第23章 人品爆发签到混沌道果第24章 你的余生有我陪你渡过
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: “我等赞同十七祖的提议”众族老纷纷附议。
“既然如此，那就按此执行，事关林琅天能够修炼之事，大家不可外泄”。
“两位老祖，现在还剩一个问题没解决了”君家主插话了。
“嗯？有情你指的是…”十八祖恍然大悟。
“正是大道圣心之事，圣心有缺，圣体不全，所以不解决这事终会，影响到林琅天未来”。
嗯？便宜岳父现在就开始为上门女婿着想了？
林琅天看到这一幕，心中还是有那么挺感动的，比起林家，君家实在是好上太多了。
虽然年轻一辈有些矛盾纷争，但也是君家激励晚辈，前进的一种方式，并不会影响到长辈的决策。
比起林家兄弟相残的狗血剧情，君家的矛盾真的不算事。
感受到这种家族氛围，挺好的，很适合苟起来发育。
“就算现在把林家那个小子杀了，换回圣心，也没用了，都成长了这么久时间了，与林家那小子结为一体了。”
十七神微微沉吟，眼神微眯。
“要不猎杀一位圣人？比如那种作恶多端的魔修者？”有族老建议；
“行不通的，不说不匹配，就算匹配，他们圣心也就普通的圣人，移植到大道圣体身上，将来也只会成为大道圣体的负累”
马上又有族老发表不同的看法。
“家族有没有什么宝物可以修复，或者重新催生一个圣心的宝物”
十八祖向君有情询问；
君有情思绪了会道：“家族有天道神石，如意玉灵芯，还有圣源胎心，万物源气丹，玄黄造生丹。
目前修复圣心缺陷有作用的，族内有库存的就这些”。
“那就全部拿过来送给琅天小子吧，只要能造出完美的圣体，一切都是值得的”
十八祖直接大气说道；
“啊，这……”君有情傻眼了，这些宝物随便一件都堪比无价之宝。
原以为会挑一样送给林琅天这小子，没想到竟然全部送。
身为家主的君有情也突觉一阵肉疼，不由得眼睁睁的看着十七祖。
十七祖感受到了，君有情求救似的目光，装作看不见的样子，老神在在的一副，眼观鼻鼻观心的模样。
君有情看见十七祖这样子，也知道求救无望，又转头看向众族老。
众族老也觉得给的太多了，正想开口，看见十八祖眼神含着杀气的望过来，纷纷闭口不言。
content_en:
"We agree with the Seventeenth Ancestor's proposal." All the clan elders agreed one after another.
"In this case, let's follow this. It is related to Lin Langtian's ability to practice, and no one should let it out."
"Two ancestors, there is still one problem that remains to be solved," the head of the Jun family interrupted.
"Huh? Youqing, you mean..." The Eighteenth Patriarch suddenly realized.
"It is a matter of the Sacred Heart of the Dao. The Sacred Heart is lacking and the Holy Body is incomplete. Therefore, if this matter is not resolved, it will eventually affect Lin Langtian's future."
Um? The cheap father-in-law is now thinking about his son-in-law?
When Lin Langtian saw this scene, he was still very moved. Compared to the Lin family, the Jun family was much better.
Although the younger generation has some conflicts and disputes, it is also a way for the Jun family to motivate the younger generation and move forward, and will not affect the decision-making of the elders.
Compared with the bloody plot of the Lin brothers fighting each other, the conflicts between the Jun family are really nothing.
It's good to feel this kind of family atmosphere, and it's very suitable for growing up and growing up.
"Even if we kill that boy from the Lin family now and replace him with the Sacred Heart, it's useless. He has grown up for so long and has become one with that boy from the Lin family."
The Seventeen Gods pondered slightly and narrowed their eyes.
"How about hunting down a saint? For example, a demon cultivator who has done many evil things?" A clan elder suggested;
"It won't work. Not to mention that it doesn't match. Even if they match, their Sacred Hearts are just like ordinary saints. If they are transplanted into the Holy Body of the Great Dao, they will only become a burden to the Holy Body of the Great Dao in the future."
Immediately, another clan elder expressed a different view.
"Does the family have any treasures that can be repaired or reborn as a sacred heart treasure?"
The Eighteenth Patriarch asked you affectionately;
Jun Youqing thought for a while and said: "The family has the Divine Stone of Heavenly Dao, the Ruyi Jade Spiritual Core, the Holy Source Fetal Heart, the Source Qi Pill of All Things, and the Xuanhuang Life-creating Pill.
Currently, these are the ones that are effective in repairing the defects of the Sacred Heart, and the clan has stocks in them."
"Then take them all and give them to Langtian boy. As long as you can create a perfect holy body, everything will be worth it."
The Eighteenth Patriarch said directly and grandly;
"Ah, this..." Jun Youqing was dumbfounded. Any one of these treasures is priceless.
I thought I would pick one thing to give to this guy Lin Langtian, but I didn’t expect to give it all.
As the head of the family, Jun Youqing suddenly felt a pain in his body and couldn't help but look at the Seventeenth Ancestor.
The Seventeenth Ancestor felt Jun Youqing's look as if he was begging for help, and pretended not to see it, as if the old god was there, looking at his nose and heart.
Seeing the seventeenth ancestor like this, Jun Youqing knew that there was no hope of seeking help, so he turned to look at the elders of the clan.
The clan elders also felt that the gift was too much, and just as they were about to speak, they saw the Eighteenth Patriarch looking at him with murderous intent in his eyes, and they all fell silent.
